name: Switchroom water-ingress detection interface
summary: Receives the installed water detector's indication for the assigned room or trench area.
description: Receives the installed water detector's indication for the assigned room or trench area. Environmental supervision turns measurements or contact states into clearly named room-service indications. A sensor measures a condition; the supervisory function decides whether the assigned alarm or control response is needed.

In a switchroom, water ingress, temperature, humidity and equipment-service alarms can be sent to the station controller with separate point names so an operator can identify the affected area. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Water-detection contact” at the input and “Water-ingress alarm” at the output. The detector covers only its defined sensing area.

Keep sensor location, alarm thresholds, delay and monitoring coverage in the room-services schedule. An environmental alarm is a diagnostic input, not a complete assessment of electrical equipment condition. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
